items.headline: Hydrologic Outlook issued June 22 at 1:52PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
ESFAFG

...Locations Impacted...
Eastern Alaska Range South of Trims Camp-Northern Denali
Borough-Southern Denali Borough-Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims
Camp

A front is expected to move westward over the state throughout the
beginning of this week. As this front progresses, we are expecting
widespread rain showers and thunderstorms to begin Tuesday morning
for the eastern Alaska Range and spread west by Tuesday afternoon
during the time of heaviest rainfall with totals as high as 1" or

items.headline: Hydrologic Outlook issued June 22 at 1:03PM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
ESFAFC

Rainfall

* Susitna Valley: Widespread rainfall totaling 1 to 2 inches with
the highest totals likely across the northern and western portions
of the valley.

Hydrologic Concerns

* Expect sharp rises on many small streams and rivers. Many smaller
streams will crest Tuesday night into Wednesday with larger rivers
cresting Wednesday into Thursday such as the Skwentna and Yentna
rivers.

* Many lower locations along rivers such as gravel bars and other
spots popular for camping and recreat
items.areas: Western Susitna Valley; Central Susitna Valley; Northern Susitna Valley

items.headline: Red Flag Warning issued June 21 at 9:55PM AKDT until June 22 at 10:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* AFFECTED AREA...North Slopes of the Western Alaska Range and
Upper Kuskokwim Valley.

* TIMING...From 10 AM to 10 PM AKDT Monday.

* THUNDERSTORM COVERAGE INDEX...Scattered.

* WINDS...Near thunderstorms, gusts could reach as high as 30 mph.

* IMPACTS...Critical fire weather conditions are expected due to
scattered wet thunderstorms. These storms will bring frequent
lightning strikes and gusty winds that are expected to cause
new fire ignitions.
items.areas: North Slopes of the Western Alaska Range; Upper Kuskokwim Valley
items.instruction:
A Red Flag Warning means that conditions are occurring or will
occur which could lead to the development of large and dangerous
fires. It is directed toward fire agencies, and through them, to
the public.

Please advise the appropriate officials or fire crews in the
field of this Red Flag Warning.
